knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says movements are recorded at the time they happen, because a late record cannot show when a loss occurred. Recording at the end of the week (option 0) and recording only losses (option 2) are both ruled out.

The lesson says every difference between the balance and the count is investigated, as it may be a loss, a recording error or waste. Adjusting without investigating (option 0) and ignoring small differences (option 2) are both named as wrong.
The lesson says that from the movement record, a running balance is kept for each product and key item.

practicalCriteria: Learner records a supplied set of equipment and product movements with date, item, quantity, job or vehicle and person.
Learner keeps a running balance for a supplied product and compares it with a supplied stock count.
Learner investigates a difference in the count, records its cause and the action taken.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Movement record with date, item, quantity, job or vehicle and person
Stock count record with the balance, count and explanation of any difference
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 1 is not done: Record each movement of equipment and products out, in, to a job or vehicle, and returned.
